name: daycare-day-sheet-worker
description: Daycare Day Sheet Worker: the API in docs/API.md on D1. No npm dependencies; uses the wrangler on PATH. Local only.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply daycare-day-sheet --local --persist-to .state-dev && wrangler dev --local --port 7802 --inspector-port 7812 --persist-to .state-dev
scripts.dev:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply daycare-day-sheet --local --persist-to .state-dev && wrangler dev --local --port 7802 --inspector-port 7812 --persist-to .state-dev --var TEST_MODE:1
